paras: Unleash the full potential of your Audi 8Y or 8V S3 Sedan with the XFORCE VAREX SmartBox-equipped cat-back exhaust system. This system doesn’t just upgrade your exhaust—it redefines how you experience sound and control behind the wheel.

Constructed from brushed 304 stainless steel , the system features 3” mandrel-bent piping , a hot dog resonator , and a redesigned VAREX valved rear muffler , giving you a bold, aggressive tone when open and a refined, near-stock sound when closed. It’s daily-drivable with the flexibility to turn heads when you want to.
hl: Matrix Mode : Automatically adjust valve position based on speed, RPM, or throttle input.
Manual Mode : Fine-tune valve position in real time via the XFORCE app or remote.
Geo Mode: Program valve behavior by location - quiet in your neighborhood, loud on your favorite backroad.
Factory Mode (with optional cable): Seamlessly link exhaust behavior to your Audi's built-in drive mode settings.
Drone canister tube for reduced cabin drone
ft: XForce AUDI S3 8Y and 8V Sedan Varex Valved Cat Back Exhaust System with SmartBox
